Class SshClientTheme

java.lang.Object
org.casserole.app.ui.ssh.SshClientTheme
public class SshClientTheme extends Object
The SshClientTheme is the dark Metal look for the SSH window and the Aetheris window. Metal is the Swing look and feel this class customizes. The colors come from SshClientProperties. A menu hover paints a grey tab. A canvas scroll pane uses the quiet bevel. // @aa-sdd L40 aa-sdd-source-prose.md#SshClientTheme

  • Constructor Details

    • SshClientTheme

      public SshClientTheme(SshClientProperties properties)
      The constructor copies colors from the properties store. darkGround(Color, int, int) remaps a frame background that is still 0x1e1e1e to 0x0c0c0c. A panel background that is still 0x2d2d2d becomes 0x121212. A status background that is still 0x171717 becomes 0x0c0c0c. A split background that is still 0x1e1e1e becomes 0x0c0c0c. The panel foreground is stored as loaded. The field background and the field foreground are stored as loaded. The button background and the button foreground are stored as loaded. The status foreground is stored as loaded. The menu foreground is stored as loaded.
      Parameters:
      properties - The loaded client properties.

  • Method Details

    • installLookAndFeelDefaults

      public void installLookAndFeelDefaults()
      The installLookAndFeelDefaults method writes dark defaults into the Swing UI manager. Call it before the components are created. Panel.background and Label.background receive the panel background. Panel.foreground and Label.foreground receive the panel foreground. Button.background receives the button background. Button.foreground receives the button foreground. TextField.background receives the field background. TextField.foreground and TextField.caretForeground receive the field foreground. PasswordField.background receives the field background. PasswordField.foreground and PasswordField.caretForeground receive the field foreground. ComboBox.background receives the field background. ComboBox.foreground receives the field foreground. CheckBox.background receives the panel background. CheckBox.foreground receives the panel foreground. Spinner.background receives the field background. Spinner.foreground receives the field foreground. OptionPane.background receives the panel background. OptionPane.messageForeground and OptionPane.foreground receive the panel foreground. OptionPane.buttonForeground receives the panel foreground. PopupMenu.background receives the panel background. PopupMenu.foreground receives the menu foreground. Menu.background and MenuItem.background receive the panel background. Menu.foreground and MenuItem.foreground receive the menu foreground. SplitPane.background receives the split background. ScrollBar.background receives the panel background. The key control receives the panel background. The key text receives the field foreground. The key nimbusBase receives the panel background. The key nimbusFocus receives the button background. SplitPane.border becomes a raised bevel using the highlight and the shadow. SplitPaneDivider.border becomes an empty border of zero on every side. installQuietEdges() runs next. seatButtonHover() runs last.

    • seatButtonHover

      private void seatButtonHover()
      The seatButtonHover method installs the button hover colors once. A second call returns immediately. The shared tooltip delay grows by fifty milliseconds. One listener watches mouse enter and mouse exit. Another listener watches a component being added.

    • seatPlateFace

      private void seatPlateFace(AbstractButton button)
      The seatPlateFace method gives a command button the plate face. plateSkip(AbstractButton) leaves a button that already has its own face. A button with no saved ink uses the theme button foreground. The background becomes the idle plate color. The button is not opaque. The content area is not filled by the stock painter. The focus ring is not painted. Rollover is enabled. The border is an empty border of four, ten, four, and ten. A button that is not already using SshClientTheme.PlateFaceUi receives that painter.
      Parameters:
      button - The button that just joined a container.

    • plateSkip

      private static boolean plateSkip(AbstractButton button)
      The plateSkip method reports a button that should keep its own face. A component that is neither a plain button nor a toggle button returns true. A check box, a radio button, or a menu item returns true. A true aetheris.rust property returns true. A true aetheris.mark property returns true. A true aetheris.choice property returns true. A non-null aetheris.plate.selected property returns true. A button whose painter is SshClientTheme.PlateButtonUi returns true. A class name that contains Arrow returns true. A preferred size of zero width and zero height returns true. Every other button returns false.
      Parameters:
      button - The candidate button.
      Returns:
      True when this button keeps its own face.

    • installQuietEdges

      private void installQuietEdges()
      The installQuietEdges method puts the quiet grey on Metal edges. The current Metal theme becomes a SshClientTheme.QuietOcean. The raised bevel uses the highlight and the shadow. The line border uses the highlight. TabbedPane.borderHightlightColor receives the highlight. TabbedPane.contentAreaColor receives the highlight. TabbedPane.unselectedBackground receives the highlight. TabbedPane.tabAreaBackground receives the highlight. TabbedPane.background receives the highlight. TabbedPane.light, TabbedPane.highlight, TabbedPane.selectHighlight, and TabbedPane.focus receive the highlight. TabbedPane.selected receives the panel background. TabbedPane.shadow and TabbedPane.darkShadow receive the shadow. MenuBar.borderColor receives the highlight. PopupMenu.border, Menu.border, and MenuItem.border receive the line border. Menu.selectionBackground and MenuItem.selectionBackground receive the panel background. Menu.selectionForeground and MenuItem.selectionForeground receive the menu foreground. Button.border receives the raised bevel. Spinner.border receives the line border. Spinner.arrowButtonBorder receives the raised bevel. TextField.border, PasswordField.border, and FormattedTextField.border receive the line border. CheckBox.gradient receives quietFill(). CheckBox.rollover is false. ComboBox.selectionBackground receives the panel background. ComboBox.selectionForeground receives the field foreground. List.focusCellHighlightBorder and Table.focusCellHighlightBorder receive the line border. RootPane.plainDialogBorder receives the line border. RootPane.informationDialogBorder receives the line border. RootPane.errorDialogBorder receives the line border. RootPane.questionDialogBorder receives the line border. RootPane.warningDialogBorder receives the line border. RootPane.fileChooserDialogBorder receives the line border. RootPane.colorChooserDialogBorder receives the line border.

    • quietFill

      private static List<Object> quietFill()
      The quietFill method builds the flat check-box gradient. The first value is 0.3. The second value is 0. The next three values are the bevel highlight.

    • darkGround

      private static Color darkGround(Color loaded, int oldRgb, int nextRgb)
      The darkGround method replaces an old default ground. The comparison ignores the alpha byte. A loaded color whose remaining bytes match oldRgb returns nextRgb as an opaque color. Any other loaded color is returned unchanged.
      Parameters:
      loaded - The color from the properties store.
      oldRgb - The previous default, without alpha.
      nextRgb - The dark ground, without alpha.
      Returns:
      The dark ground, or the loaded color when it is not the old default.

    • applyPopup

      public void applyPopup(JPopupMenu menu)
      The applyPopup method paints a context menu. A null menu returns immediately. The menu is opaque. The background is the panel background. The foreground is the menu foreground. The border is a line in the button background. The painter is a basic popup painter. paintMenuComponent(Component) then paints every child.
      Parameters:
      menu - The menu to paint.

    • paintMenuComponent

      private void paintMenuComponent(Component component)
      The paintMenuComponent method paints one context-menu row. A nested menu is not opaque. That menu uses the panel background and the menu foreground. seatMenuHover(JMenuItem) installs its hover tab. applyPopup(JPopupMenu) paints the nested popup. A menu item that is not a menu uses the same background and foreground. That item is not opaque. An item whose class is exactly JMenuItem receives the hover tab. A subclass of JMenuItem does not receive that tab. A separator uses the panel background and the menu foreground. Any other component is left unchanged.
      Parameters:
      component - The row to paint.

    • applyTextField

      public void applyTextField(JTextField field)
      The applyTextField method paints a text field. The background is the field background. The foreground, the caret, and the selected text use the field colors. The selection color is the button background. The selected text color is the button foreground. The border is a button-background line around an empty inset of three, four, three, and four. The field is opaque.
      Parameters:
      field - The field to paint.

    • applyPasswordField

      public void applyPasswordField(JPasswordField field)
      The applyPasswordField method paints a password field. The field is passed to applyTextField(JTextField).
      Parameters:

    • applyCanvasScroll

      public void applyCanvasScroll(JScrollPane pane)
      The applyCanvasScroll method paints the scroll pane under the canvas tab. A null pane returns immediately. applyScrollPane(JScrollPane) arms the overlay bars. The pane background is the panel background. The border is a raised bevel. The lit edge is the bevel highlight. The dark edge is the bevel shadow. The viewport border is removed. // @aa-sdd L40 aa-sdd-source-prose.md FINESSE:f-138 // @aa-sdd L40 aa-sdd-source-prose.md FINESSE:f-139
      Parameters:
      pane - The scroll pane under the canvas tab.

    • applyCheckBox

      public void applyCheckBox(JCheckBox checkBox)
      The applyCheckBox method paints a check box. The background is the panel background. The foreground is the panel foreground. The box is opaque. The focus ring is not painted. One SshClientTheme.SapphireCheck is used for the normal, selected, rollover, pressed, and disabled icons.
      Parameters:
      checkBox - The check box to paint.

    • applyMenuBar

      public void applyMenuBar(JMenuBar bar)
      The applyMenuBar method paints the window menu. A null bar returns immediately. The bar is opaque. The background is the panel background. Each menu item is not opaque. Each menu item uses the menu foreground. seatMenuHover(JMenuItem) installs the grey hover tab on each menu item. A child that is not a menu item is skipped. // @aa-sdd L40 aa-sdd-source-prose.md FINESSE:f-130
      Parameters:
      bar - The menu bar.

    • seatMenuHover

      private static void seatMenuHover(JMenuItem item)
      The seatMenuHover method installs the grey hover tab. Rollover is enabled. A menu receives SshClientTheme.HoverMenuUi. Any other item receives SshClientTheme.HoverMenuItemUi.
      Parameters:
      item - The menu title or the menu row.

    • applyComboBox

      public void applyComboBox(JComboBox<?> comboBox)
      The applyComboBox method paints a combo box. The background is the field background. The foreground is the field foreground. The combo box is opaque. seatComboArrow(JComboBox) replaces the arrow.
      Parameters:
      comboBox - The combo box to paint.

    • seatComboArrow

      private void seatComboArrow(JComboBox<?> comboBox)
      The seatComboArrow method replaces each Metal arrow button. A child that is not a Metal combo button is skipped. The arrow is a triangle in the hover green. The field colors are left unchanged. // @aa-sdd L40 aa-sdd-source-prose.md FINESSE:f-154
      Parameters:
      comboBox - The combo box whose arrow is replaced.

    • applySpinner

      public void applySpinner(JSpinner spinner)
      The applySpinner method paints a spinner. The background is the field background. The foreground is the field foreground. The spinner is opaque. A default editor has its text field passed to applyTextField(JTextField). Any other editor is left unchanged.
      Parameters:
      spinner - The spinner to paint.

    • applySplitPane

      public void applySplitPane(JSplitPane splitPane)
      The applySplitPane method paints a split pane. The background is the split background. The pane is opaque. The border is removed. One-touch expansion is turned on. The left and right components are remembered. The painter becomes a SshClientTheme.DarkSplitUi. A non-null left component is put back. A non-null right component is put back. One-touch expansion is turned on again. The divider size becomes DIVIDER_SIZE.
      Parameters:
      splitPane - The split pane to paint.

    • installPlateTabs

      public void installPlateTabs(JTabbedPane tabs)
      The installPlateTabs method installs the plate tab painter. The painter is a SshClientTheme.PlateTabUi. The strip is opaque. The background is red 13, green 13, blue 13. The border is removed.
      Parameters:
      tabs - The product tabs or the canvas tabs.

    • installPlateButton

      public void installPlateButton(JButton button, boolean selected)
      The installPlateButton method paints a folded SSH or Aetheris button. The property aetheris.plate.selected stores the selected flag. The button is not opaque. The content area is not filled by the stock painter. The focus ring is not painted. The border is an empty border of two, eight, two, and eight. Rollover is enabled. A button that is not already using SshClientTheme.PlateButtonUi receives that painter. A button that already uses it is repainted.
      Parameters:
      button - The folded product button.
      selected - True when this button matches the selected tab.

    • paintMenuTab

      private static void paintMenuTab(Graphics g, JMenuItem item)
      The paintMenuTab method paints the grey hover tab. A null item returns immediately. A null graphics context returns immediately. The tab is painted when the model is in rollover, armed, or selected. An idle row returns without painting, so the bar ground shows through. Antialiasing is turned on. The color is red 70, green 70, blue 70. The rectangle starts one pixel in from the top and the left. The width and the height are two pixels smaller than the item. A negative size is painted as zero. The corner arc is six pixels. The graphics copy is disposed.
      Parameters:
      g - The menu graphics.
      item - The row.
